name: globalisationinevitable
question: Should economic globalisation prove unavoidable, its main beneficiary ought to be humanity, not multinational business.
source_question: If economic globalisation is inevitable, it should primarily serve humanity rather than the interests of trans-national corporations.

name: countryrightorwrong
question: My country would have my backing regardless of whether it was in the right.
source_question: I’d always support my country, whether it was right or wrong.

name: proudofcountry
question: Since where you are born is an accident of birth, national pride makes little sense.
source_question: No one chooses their country of birth, so it’s foolish to be proud of it.

name: racequalities
question: Compared with other races, ours possesses many better qualities.
source_question: Our race has many superior qualities, compared with other races.

name: enemyenemyfriend
question: Whoever opposes my adversary should be counted an ally.
source_question: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.

name: militaryactionlaw
question: There are occasions when using military force in breach of international law is warranted.
source_question: Military action that defies international law is sometimes justified.

name: fusioninfotainment
question: News and entertainment have merged in a way that should concern us.
source_question: There is now a worrying fusion of information and entertainment.

name: classthannationality
question: In the end, class divides people more deeply than nationality does.
source_question: People are ultimately divided more by class than by nationality.

name: inflationoverunemployment
question: Keeping inflation down should take priority over keeping people in work.
source_question: Controlling inflation is more important than controlling unemployment.

name: corporationstrust
question: Regulation of corporations is needed because they will not protect the environment of their own accord.
source_question: Because corporations cannot be trusted to voluntarily protect the environment, they require regulation.

name: fromeachability
question: The principle of contributing by ability and receiving by need is sound at its core.
source_question: “from each according to his ability, to each according to his need” is a fundamentally good idea.

name: freermarketfreerpeople
question: People become freer as markets become freer.
source_question: The freer the market, the freer the people.

name: bottledwater
question: That drinking water has become a branded product sold in bottles says something dispiriting about us.
source_question: It’s a sad reflection on our society that something as basic as drinking water is now a bottled, branded consumer product.

name: landcommodity
question: Buying and selling land as a commodity is wrong.
source_question: Land shouldn’t be a commodity to be bought and sold.

name: manipulatemoney
question: It is a shame that so many fortunes are made by people who shuffle money around while giving society nothing.
source_question: It is regrettable that many personal fortunes are made by people who simply manipulate money and contribute nothing to their society.

name: protectionismnecessary
question: There are times when protective trade measures are needed.
source_question: Protectionism is sometimes necessary in trade.

name: companyshareholders
question: Returning a profit to shareholders should be a company's sole social duty.
source_question: The only social responsibility of a company should be to deliver a profit to its shareholders.

name: richtaxed
question: Tax rates on wealthy people are excessive.
source_question: The rich are too highly taxed.

name: paymedical
question: People able to pay more ought to be able to obtain better medical care.
source_question: Those with the ability to pay should have access to higher standards of medical care.

name: penalisemislead
question: Firms that deceive the public should face government penalties.
source_question: Governments should penalise businesses that mislead the public.

name: freepredatormulinational
question: For a market to be truly free, predatory multinationals must be prevented from forming monopolies.
source_question: A genuine free market requires restrictions on the ability of predator multinationals to create monopolies.

name: abortionillegal
question: Where the woman's life is not at risk, abortion ought to be banned in every case.
source_question: Abortion, when the woman’s life is not threatened, should always be illegal.

name: questionauthority
question: Every form of authority ought to be challenged.
source_question: All authority should be questioned.

name: eyeforeye
question: Wrongs should be repaid in kind, measure for measure.
source_question: An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.

name: taxtotheatres
question: Theatres and museums that cannot pay their own way have no claim on public money.
source_question: Taxpayers should not be expected to prop up any theatres or museums that cannot survive on a commercial basis.

name: schoolscompulsory
question: Attending class ought to be optional rather than required.
source_question: Schools should not make classroom attendance compulsory.

name: ownkind
question: Everyone has rights, yet we are all better off when different sorts of people stay among their own.
source_question: All people have their rights, but it is better for all of us that different sorts of people should keep to their own kind.

name: spankchildren
question: Even good parents will occasionally need to smack a child.
source_question: Good parents sometimes have to spank their children.

name: naturalsecrets
question: Children keeping a few things from their parents is perfectly normal.
source_question: It’s natural for children to keep some secrets from their parents.

name: marijuanalegal
question: Holding cannabis for one's own use ought not to be treated as a crime.
source_question: Possessing marijuana for personal use should not be a criminal offence.

name: schooljobs
question: Schools exist first and foremost to prepare young people for the job market.
source_question: The prime function of schooling should be to equip the future generation to find jobs.

name: inheritablereproduce
question: Those carrying serious heritable disabilities ought to be barred from having children.
source_question: People with serious inheritable disabilities should not be allowed to reproduce.

name: childrendiscipline
question: Above all else, children need to learn to submit to discipline.
source_question: The most important thing for children to learn is to accept discipline.

name: savagecivilised
question: No people is savage and none civilised; there are simply different cultures.
source_question: There are no savage and civilised peoples; there are only different cultures.

name: abletowork
question: People capable of working who turn down the chance have no claim on society's help.
source_question: Those who are able to work, and refuse the opportunity, should not expect society’s support.

name: represstroubles
question: Faced with worries, one does better to stay occupied with pleasanter matters than to dwell on them.
source_question: When you are troubled, it’s better not to think about it, but to keep busy with more cheerful things.

name: immigrantsintegrated
question: Those who immigrate themselves will never fully become part of their adopted country.
source_question: First-generation immigrants can never be fully integrated within their new country.

name: goodforcorporations
question: Whatever benefits the biggest corporations ends up benefiting everyone.
source_question: What’s good for the most successful corporations is always, ultimately, good for all of us.

name: broadcastingfunding
question: Public money should never go to a broadcaster, however independent its output.
source_question: No broadcasting institution, however independent its content, should receive public funding.

name: libertyterrorism
question: Counter-terrorism has gone too far in restricting our civil freedoms.
source_question: Our civil liberties are being excessively curbed in the name of counter-terrorism.

name: onepartystate
question: One-party rule has the genuine benefit of sidestepping the disputes that slow democracies down.
source_question: A significant advantage of a one-party state is that it avoids all the arguments that delay progress in a democratic political system.

name: serveillancewrongdoers
question: Electronic technology has made official monitoring easier, but the innocent have nothing to fear from it.
source_question: Although the electronic age makes official surveillance easier, only wrongdoers need to be worried.

name: deathpenalty
question: Capital punishment ought to remain available for the gravest offences.
source_question: The death penalty should be an option for the most serious crimes.

name: societyheirarchy
question: Civilised life requires a ladder of superiors to obey and subordinates to direct.
source_question: In a civilised society, one must always have people above to be obeyed and people below to be commanded.

name: abstractart
question: Non-representational abstract work does not deserve to be called art.
source_question: Abstract art that doesn’t represent anything shouldn’t be considered art at all.

name: punishmentrehabilitation
question: Justice systems ought to weight punishment above reform of the offender.
source_question: In criminal justice, punishment should be more important than rehabilitation.

name: wastecriminals
question: With certain criminals, attempts at rehabilitation are a pointless use of time.
source_question: It is a waste of time to try to rehabilitate some criminals.

name: businessart
question: Those who run businesses and make goods matter more than those who write and create art.
source_question: The businessperson and the manufacturer are more important than the writer and the artist.

name: mothershomemakers
question: A mother may hold a job, but her primary obligation is to the home.
source_question: Mothers may have careers, but their first duty is to be homemakers.

name: plantresources
question: Politicians nearly all pledge economic growth, yet climate science warns that growth undermines the fight against global warming, and we should listen.
source_question: Almost all politicians promise economic growth, but we should heed the warnings of climate science that growth is detrimental to our efforts to curb global warming.

name: peacewithestablishment
question: Part of growing up is learning to make peace with the established order.
source_question: Making peace with the establishment is an important aspect of maturity.

name: astrology
question: There is much that astrology explains correctly.
source_question: Astrology accurately explains many things.

name: moralreligious
question: Morality is impossible in the absence of religion.
source_question: You cannot be moral without being religious.

name: charitysocialsecurity
question: For those truly in need, charitable giving works better than state welfare.
source_question: Charity is better than social security as a means of helping the genuinely disadvantaged.

name: naturallyunlucky
question: Certain people are simply born unlucky.
source_question: Some people are naturally unlucky.

name: schoolreligious
question: I want the school my child attends to instil religious values.
source_question: It is important that my child’s school instills religious values.

name: sexoutsidemarriage
question: As a rule, sex outside of marriage is wrong.
source_question: Sex outside marriage is usually immoral.

name: homosexualadoption
question: Same-sex couples in settled, loving relationships ought to be allowed to adopt a child.
source_question: A same sex couple in a stable, loving relationship should not be excluded from the possibility of child adoption.

name: pornography
question: Adults should be legally free to view pornography made by consenting adults.
source_question: Pornography, depicting consenting adults, should be legal for the adult population.

name: consentingprivate
question: The state has no business in the private bedroom of consenting adults.
source_question: What goes on in a private bedroom between consenting adults is no business of the state.

name: naturallyhomosexual
question: Homosexual feeling is never something that comes naturally.
source_question: No one can feel naturally homosexual.

name: opennessaboutsex
question: Society has become too open about sexual matters.
source_question: These days openness about sex has gone too far.
